name: The Cut List
why_it_works: Almost everyone has been left off some list. Opening on the rejection hooks that old sting, and the hidden training montage gives the viewer a picture of the effort they wish they had made. The payoff feels earned because we saw the cost.

hook.pattern: Open on the rejection itself, with an age, before any context.
examples: I got cut at {{cut_age}}. This is the list.
At {{cut_age}}, my name wasn't on the list.
Cut at {{cut_age}}. Here's what I did next.

variables.name: cut_age
variables.description: Age when the athlete was cut

variables.name: low_point
variables.description: The concrete low point after the cut, a full spoken sentence starting with a capital letter, no end punctuation, 12 words or fewer
variables.example: I stopped telling people I played

variables.name: daily_work
variables.description: The unseen daily routine that followed, spoken, 12 words or fewer
variables.example: 5 a.m. sprints before school, 300 shots after

variables.name: payoff_moment
variables.description: The moment it paid off, real and specific, spoken, 10 words or fewer
variables.example: the first varsity start, two years later

variables.name: team_colors
variables.description: Team or brand colors for the hero shot

variables.name: offer
variables.description: What viewers can do next, starting with a capital letter, spoken, 4 words or fewer

variables.name: disclosure
variables.description: Required fine print for the client's niche, from compliance/packs.json, shown as small on-screen text
variables.example: Results vary. These statements have not been evaluated by the FDA.

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photo of a printed team roster pinned to a corkboard in a school hallway, one name missing, harsh fluorescent light, shallow focus
Vertical photo of a young athlete alone on an empty court or field at dusk, sitting on the ground with gear beside them, long shadows, cold color
Vertical 9:16 tracking shot of an athlete training alone before sunrise, breath visible, streetlights still on, gritty handheld feel

beats.purpose: the turn: the moment it paid off

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 slow-motion shot of an athlete in {{team_colors}} at the peak of a decisive play under stadium lights, crowd blurred behind, dramatic rim light

craft.notes: The rejection should be an object (the roster), not a speech. Keep the training beat lonely and early-morning so it reads as sacrifice. Spend the one hero clip on the payoff only; everything before it stays cheap and cold so the hero moment pops.

do_not: Use a real league's logos or a real player's likeness
Promise viewers they will go pro
Let the montage run long; one strong training shot beats five
compliance: Fitness trainers and coaches: no promise of going pro, scholarships, or body and performance results; this is one athlete's story, not a typical result
Label realistic AI-generated athlete or game footage with the platform's AI-content label; never present it as real game footage
No real league, school or team logos without permission
